newsitem.title: USA: Country World Casinos gets financing.
newsitem.headline: Country World Casinos gets financing.

text.p: Country World Casinos said Thursday that it signed a financing agreement for building a casino in Black Hawk, Colo.
Terms of the agreement call for an initial private placement financing of $10 million to be provided through U2 Consulting, a subsidiary of Pacific Genesis Group.
Additionally, as part of the total financing, Country World has recieved a firm committment for a total of $65 million to be provided as required during construction.
Previously, U2 Consulting said it would raise the capital through the issuance of five year notes.
